detail: Acceptance criterion 1 requires create/edit to work in demo; r1 shipped exactly this class of bug (mutations silently no-op). A dropped 'Some(next)' or broken add_days_iso passes make test and both lints — lint checks guarding, not store threading.

title: Demo download pinned only at the id-mapping layer — parse_relative_uri arm, map_pdf_result error paths, filename fallback, and baked-asset presence all untested
detail: r1 B1 had two halves; only the mapping half is pinned. A regression back to uri.parse, a deleted/renamed PDF, or a broken non-2xx/empty-body branch passes every check — every demo download would toast an error.
recommended_fix: Make map_pdf_result pub and unit-test 2xx/empty/non-2xx; add a CI step asserting every report_filenames() key has a non-empty server/priv/static/demo/report-<id>.pdf.
